protocol.candidate_policy: Preview the real uniform stage/window choice; draw one different stored window of the same length from that stage using a separate observation-indexed RNG. Replace uniform only when the alternative has larger positive weighted loss increase.
protocol.checkpoint_policy: Ordinary native state plus a checksummed .sgpriority policy sidecar; no promotion.
protocol.primary: Complete development binding-group accuracy, priority minus both uniform controls, for each seed and budget.
protocol.gate: Priority must improve binding accuracy over both controls in all three seeds under each budget, lose no more than 0.02 nats/byte on each of three development books against either control, and not reduce binding accuracy from its ancestor. A pilot engineering gate, not general reliability.
protocol.timing: Native loop only, including scoring/capture and scheduled speech. Excludes model/source load, final save and all assessments. Time arms stop after the first completed tick reaching six seconds.
protocol.limitations: One run per seed/mode/budget. Repeated development material; no reserved tests or quality tuning. Immediate interference may not predict durable retention. Native threshold sensitivity persists.
